beat: Tuesday twins tuition preparations, pre-competition scheduling and focused two-hour study
translationStatus: complete working local draft / author review pending

lines.original: Feeling the heat of the day, she wore a cute little while short and a matching half hand T shirt.... It had a v neck, but it started right below her neck with no place for any cleavage... she didn't want any distractions today. She was also glad that Pappu is still sleeping at aunty's place and later, aunty and Pappu would leave to temple and then park. She wanted to catch up on the studies with the twins.
lines.local: Garmi ke chalte usne cute white shorts aur matching half-sleeve T-shirt pehni. V-neck collar bilkul gardan ke neeche se shuru hota tha aur cleavage nahi dikhta tha; aaj distraction bilkul nahi chahiye tha. Pappu Aunty ke ghar so raha tha, aur baad mein Aunty use temple aur park le jaayengi. Dhika twins ki padhai cover karna chahti thi.

lines.original: Ding Dong.....
lines.local: Ding dong...

lines.original: Dhika: She ran tip toed to her door....and opening with a smile... Come in dears..... its like I am seeing you both here, together, after a long time....hehe
lines.local: Dhika tiptoe karti muskurakar darwaaze par bhaagi: Aao dears! Lag raha hai tum dono ko ek saath yahan dekhe bahut din ho gaye, hehe.

lines.original: Bantu: I saw you last time miss.... he winked at her and looked at her breast...
lines.local: Bantu: Last time toh maine aapko dekha tha, miss. Usne aankh maari aur unke breasts ki taraf dekha.

lines.original: Dhika: aii... don't start being naughty... hehe.. come in first....
lines.local: Dhika: Aii, aate hi naughty mat bano, hehe. Pehle andar aao.

lines.original: Bobby just smiled and remembered what all "he" saw last time.... Dhika noticed Bobby thinking and thought, if he is thinking the same as her.
lines.local: Bobby bas muskuraya aur yaad karne laga pichhli baar usne kya dekha tha. Dhika ne uski soch notice ki aur socha kya woh bhi wahi baat soch raha hai jo woh.

lines.original: Bantu and Bobby entered,....and each gave a quick hug to their teacher and sat on the floor, and took out their notes.
lines.local: Bantu aur Bobby andar aaye, teacher ko ek-ek quick hug diya, farsh par baithkar notes nikaal liye.

lines.original: Bobby: miss... we only have a couple of more days to get ready, before we leave off to the competition....
lines.local: Bobby: Miss, competition ke liye nikalne se pehle sirf kuch din bache hain.

lines.original: Dhika: oh really.... I thought we had time..
lines.local: Dhika: Achha? Mujhe laga abhi time hai.

lines.original: Bantu: no miss... its coming Saturday.....
lines.local: Bantu: Nahi miss, aane waale Saturday ko hai.

lines.original: Dhika: ohhh..... have we covered everything we have to ?
lines.local: Dhika: Ohh, toh jo cover karna tha sab kar liya?

lines.original: Bobby: yes miss.... we have.... pretty much done... just a couple of more topics left.
lines.local: Bobby: Haan miss, lagbhag saara ho gaya. Sirf kuch topics reh gaye hain.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... thats a relief to hear......
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, yeh sunkar rahat mili.

lines.original: Bantu: yes miss.... but can we meet tomorrow and day after tomorrow miss..
lines.local: Bantu: Haan miss, lekin kal aur parson bhi mil sakte hain?

lines.original: Dhika: oohh.... sorry dear... but tomorrow and day after tomorrow, both days I am going to be working late in college... it will be very late by the time I reach home....
lines.local: Dhika: Oh sorry dear, kal aur parson dono din college mein late tak kaam hai. Ghar bahut der se pahunchungi.

lines.original: Both Bobby and Bantu put on a sad face.... They have pretty much covered all topics, but they just wanted to spend more alone time with her....
lines.local: Bobby aur Bantu dono ke chehre utar gaye. Topics toh lagbhag cover the, par woh unke saath thoda aur akele waqt bitaana chahte the.

lines.original: Dhika: common,.... don't get sad now... today you can spend 2 - 3 hours here.... I am free all day.... and then coming friday, we can meet again....
lines.local: Dhika: Arre, udaas mat ho. Aaj do-teen ghante reh sakte ho; main poora din free hoon. Phir Friday ko milenge.

lines.original: Bantu: oh,... Friday I thought we will take off to rest and relax miss...
lines.local: Bantu: Oh, mujhe laga Friday ko rest aur relaxation ke liye chhutti lenge miss.

lines.original: Dhika: ha ha... don't even think that I would leave you guys without a test.... hehe... you are coming on Friday.
lines.local: Dhika hansi: Bilkul mat sochna test ke bina jaane dungi, hehe. Friday ko aana hi hai!

lines.original: Bobby just giggled while Bantu put on a sad face.....
lines.local: Bobby khilkhilaaya; Bantu ne udaas chehra bana liya.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... you can worry later... now open the books. Lets start on the left over topics...
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, chinta baad mein kar lena. Ab books kholo, bache topics start karte hain.

lines.original: All 3 dived into their books and studied without any distractions for next 2 hours... There was nothing that could distract them.... Dhika wearing a proper T shirt and the boys, deterministic to finish everything by today.... they all did not even move an inch from their place......
lines.local: Teeno agle do ghante bina distraction padhte rahe. Dhika proper T-shirt pehne thi aur boys aaj saara syllabus khatam karne par focused the; apni jagah se hilay bhi nahi.
